text:
Laura (Sales): Hey team — kicking off a POC convo for Odin Corp. They want to validate a semantic search + RAG flow over internal docs. Main asks: DPA/SOC2 artifacts, HIPAA/GDPR considerations (they may have PHI in some records), and an acceptance criteria checklist. Timeline they proposed is ~6 weeks. Also pricing question: hosted API vs short-term dedicated pool. Any blockers?
Anand (SE): I can lead tech scoping. Quick Qs: expected QPS, typical doc size, and whether they want embeddings-only or end-to-end RAG with generation? For latency target we should set a p95 goal (recommend <= 200ms for search embeddings + retrieval; <= 700ms for generator).
Jenna (Customer Success): Odin mentioned ~50 QPS peak, avg doc length ~1-2k tokens, and will run 10k evaluative queries during the POC. They said some doc sets contain PHI — likely need HIPAA guardrails.
Maria (Product): Suggested POC success criteria draft: 1) Precision@5 >= 0.75 on their eval set, 2) p95 latency within their SLOs, 3) cost per query below their threshold (TBD), 4) no data exfil evidence in logs + agreed data handling. Deliverables: runbook, model/config snapshot, eval report, and a short demo script.
Derek (Security): From security side we need: DPA signed, SOC2 Type II report (or SOC2 bridge letter if recent), pen-test schedule/attestation, and if PHI in scope then a BAA + evidence of encryption at rest/in transit + KMS option. Also need clarification on data residency (EU vs US).
Laura (Sales): Odin's legal will ask for sample artifacts this week. Can we produce a redacted SOC2 and our standard DPA?
Derek (Security): Yes we can provide redacted SOC2 Type II and our standard DPA template. For BAA/HIPAA: we support BAAs but recommend Private (VPC) or On‑prem. Hosted API can be used only if they accept the additional controls we apply — but on PHI we usually push for Private.
Anand (SE): For POC infra options: 1) Hosted (fastest) — spin up model on Redwood hosted with data logging disabled and short retention; 2) Temporary Dedicated — reserve small GPU pool for predictable perf; 3) Private (VPC) — mirrors production controls and required for PHI. Pricing roughback: Hosted: ~$0.12 / 1k tokens (example) depending on model; Dedicated: monthly commit, estimate $Xk/mo for a small pool (will calc after model selection).
Laura (Sales): Would a 4-week POC with Dedicated be reasonable? They want production-like latency and perf numbers.
Anand (SE): 4 weeks is OK if we scope evals tightly. Ask them to provide: - sample corpus (redacted) - 10k eval queries + expected labels - target SLOs (latency/recall/cost). We'll run parallel runs on hosted vs dedicated and show deltas.
Maria (Product): Acceptance gates idea: Phase 1 (week 0-1) onboarding + data ingest, Phase 2 (week 2) baseline run (hosted small model), Phase 3 (week 3) performance tuning on Dedicated/quantized variant, Phase 4 (week 4) final eval & handoff. If HIPAA in scope, swap Phase 1 to include BAA and Private deployment prep which adds 1-2 weeks.
Jenna (Customer Success): Odin is ok to provide a redacted corpus. They flagged two specific blockers: (1) need our pen-test report or willingness to schedule a customer-facing pen test window, (2) an explicit data deletion SLA for POC data (they want 30 days max).
Derek (Security): We can share past pen-test summary and offer to schedule a scoped pentest during week 3. Data deletion SLA: we can commit to deletion of customer POC data within 30 days post-POC for Hosted/Dedicated; for Private deployment they control retention. Need contract language for that.
Anand (SE): To make testing reproducible, request their evaluation harness and provide a sample prompt set example: ```
# sample eval prompt
Query: "Find contract clauses that mention termination for convenience."
Expected: list of clauses or doc ids with relevance score >= 0.7
Metrics: recall@5, MRR, avg latency (ms)
```
Laura (Sales): Legal will ask about DPA changes and additional obligations. Derek, can you and Maria prepare an annotated list of what we can accept vs. what requires escalation?
Derek (Security): I'll draft a short matrix: DPA items we accept (data processing, subprocessor list, standard liability caps), items needing legal review (BAA language, aggressive data deletion/forensic requirements).
deploy-bot: "Deployment scheduled: staging cluster reserved for odin-poc on 2026-04-08 09:00 UTC"
Anand (SE): Quick config snippet for Dedicated test (example): ```json
{
  "model": "redwood-1-large",
  "quantization": "4bit",
  "batch_size": 32,
  "max_seq_len": 2048,
  "cache_prefix": true
}
```
Maria (Product): Action items we agreed: - Laura: confirm whether Odin will sign BAA (yes/no) and if PHI is high-sensitivity. - Jenna: collect redacted corpus + evaluation queries by EOD Tue. - Derek: provide SOC2 redacted + DPA + pen-test summary by Thu. - Anand: cost estimate for Hosted vs 4-week Dedicated variant by Fri.
Laura (Sales): I will update Odin and push for their eval queries. One more pricing question they asked: is there a short-term discounted trial for Dedicated POC?
Anand (SE): We can offer an introductory discount on Dedicated commits for POCs; finance sign-off needed. I'll draft a numbers estimate and Laura can route to finance.
Jenna (Customer Success): Also flag: Odin expects an onboarding session (2-hr tech walkthrough) and a weekly sync. I'll schedule those after we confirm timeline.
Laura (Sales): Thanks everyone — I'll send a concise email to Odin with the ask list and timeline. If we hear back that BAA required, we will pivot to Private and adjust schedule (+1-2 weeks). :thumbsup:
Derek (Security): Note — if they insist on an external pen-test before any POC access we need two-week lead time to schedule and scope.
Anand (SE): I'll prepare a short runbook and an eval notebook we can hand them. Will attach to the POC kickoff email.
Laura (Sales): Great. I'll update thread when I hear from Odin.
Jenna (Customer Success): ping me when corpus is uploaded; I'll kick off ingestion.
Laura (Sales): (closing) thanks all — assigning owners in CRM. :rocket:
